alt: 孩子在校園展覽介紹一座以木條和葉片組成的風動作品，旁邊擺著常見紙風車。
scene_prompt: 標新立異 means creating a novel idea or approach to stand out from convention. In a modern school invention fair, a child proudly presents an original wind-powered kinetic sculpture made from simple natural wooden shapes and leaves; it slowly turns in a gentle breeze. Nearby tables show several conventional, nearly identical paper pinwheels, making the unique thoughtful design clearly stand out. Other children look curious and inspired rather than mocking. The invention is genuinely distinct and functional, not merely strange or messy. No readable signage. All figures natural with exactly two arms and two legs; sculpture has plausible balanced supports and a wind-driven pivot, clear grounded table feet. Original design.
